description: 국토교통부_노선별 경유 정류장별 이용량 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 이 데이터를 통해 노선별 수요에 따른 배차 간격 조정, 정류장 시설 개선, 혼잡 시간대 관리가 가능하며, 교통카드 데이터를 기반으로 시계열 분석, 공간 분석, 인구통계 분석, 비용. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 일일노선별경유정류장이용량, 교통카드데이터, 시계열분석, 정류장별승하차정보, 노선이용패턴. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
